👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, Goa me tourism khatam hote jaa raha hai! Zara is graph ko dhyan se dekhiye. Agar aap 2019 se 2025 ke beech Indian tourists ke travel pattern ko compare karenge, toh aapko ek shocking sach dikhayi dega. Pandemic ke baad revenge tourism ke chakkar me log itna ghumne lage hain ki Thailand mein Indian tourists ka footfall pre-pandemic levels ko cross karke 21 lakh tak pahunch chuka hai! Vietnam, jahan pehle ginti ke Indians jaate the, wahan pichle 5 saalon mein 300% ki growth hui hai! Infact, Azerbaijan… jiska naam shayad 5 saal pehle kisi ne suna bhi nahi tha… wahan Indian tourists ki sankhya 283% se badh gayi hai!
Lekin Goa mein ye graph ulta (reverse) chal raha hai. Jahan duniya aage badh rahi hai, Goa mein foreign tourists ki sankhya 50% se gir chuki hai (9 lakh se girkar sirf 4 lakh) aur domestic tourism me saturation aane laga hai! Aur hassi ki baat ye hai ki jab Goa ke tourism minister se pucha gaya ki Goa me tourism kyu nahi badh raha, toh unhone bola ki ye sab Chinese data hai!
Toh sawaal ye hai ki Goa ki tourism gir kaise rahi hai? Indians achanak se Vietnam aur Thailand jaise destinations kyu ja rahe hain? Aur Bharat sarkar ko is problem ka kya karna chahiye?
